subject: Onboarding sprint tooling roundtable
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Jenny Lopez <jenny.lopez@acmecorp.com>, onboard@acmecorp.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding sprint tooling roundtable

Hi Jenny and Acme onboarding team —

Thanks again for committing to the accelerated onboarding sprint next week. To make the kickoff efficient, we'd like to run a 60-minute tooling roundtable to align on the hands-on cadence, required recordings, and the public/internal docs you want us to surface.

Proposed agenda (attached: sprint-tooling-agenda.pdf):
- 5m: introductions & sprint goals
- 10m: required access (SSO, test data, VPC details)
- 20m: live walkthrough: Deployment + DevTools (Connor)
- 15m: recordings & async artifacts: what we’ll publish (Monica)
- 10m: Q&A + next steps / office hours slots

Ask: Can you and your engineering lead join? If SSO or networking folks should be present, please loop them in. If Wednesday 11/11 11:00AM PT doesn’t work, suggest two alternatives.

I'll record the session and drop a short lab worksheet afterwards. Attaching the agenda — please flag anything to add.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Attachment: sprint-tooling-agenda.pdf (PDF, 92KB)

From: Jenny Lopez <jenny.lopez@acmecorp.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: onboard@acmecorp.com, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding sprint tooling roundtable

Thanks Sofia — that works for us.

Quick note: please add a short SSO SAML walkthrough (we'll need clear steps for our IdP team). Also, can you confirm whether the recording will include the console demo + terminal commands? Our security folks often request the exact artifacts that will be shared.

Proposed attendees from Acme:
- Jenny Lopez (Eng lead)
- Marco Ruiz (SRE) 
- Priya Shah (Security)

Wed 11/11 11:00AM PT is OK. If anything changes I’ll ping the thread.

Best,
Jenny
Jenny Lopez
Principal Engineer, Acme Corp
jenny.lopez@acmecorp.com

Perfect — I’ll own the recording plan and the async artifacts. A few notes so we’re aligned: 

- Recording scope: full session recording (console + terminal) + a 5–7 minute trimmed highlight clip showing the deployment steps. We’ll redact any tenant-specific strings before sharing the highlight.
- Lab worksheet: short checklist + commands + sample payloads (I’ll convert to a markdown lab sheet and attach after the call: handson-lab-notes.md).
- Docs: I’ll prepare a one-pager for your Security team describing what is captured in the recording and how we sanitize it.
- Office hours: propose two 45-minute follow-ups (Mon/Tue of the sprint week) dedicated to SSO and networking deep-dive.

Link to the preliminary playbook and assets: https://docs.redwood.com/onboarding/tooling-playbook
Drive folder (upload after the call): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1sprint-agenda

Connor — if you can take the live deploy demo and include the minimal commands we should publish, that would be great.

Thanks,
Monica Patel

Subject: Re: Onboarding sprint tooling roundtable — live demo owner

I’ll take the deploy demo and make sure the terminal portion is short and repeatable. Plan:

- 6–8 step minimal deploy (docker-compose + minimal env overrides)
- show KV cache warmup and sample latency numbers (non-prod data)
- paste the exact commands into the lab notes so folks can copy/paste

I’ll also spin up a small ephemeral demo environment we can hand to Acme for the hands-on lab. Monica — I’ll upload the short script and add it to handson-lab-notes.md after the call.

HubSpot: I updated the deal with the roundtable time and action items: https://hubspot.company/deal/ACME-2026-PRD1 (note: internal playbook tag added).

—Connor

Subject: Re: Onboarding sprint tooling roundtable — recording + next steps

Thanks everyone — great sync. Recap & next steps:

1) Recording & assets: Monica will upload the full recording + trimmed highlight to the Drive by EOD tomorrow. Attachment: roundtable-recording-20261111.mp4 (we’ll push a sanitized clip to Acme’s shared folder).
2) Lab worksheet & scripts: Connor to add scripts and minimal deploy commands to handson-lab-notes.md (ETA: 11/12 10:00AM PT).
3) SSO deep-dive: schedule two follow-up office hours (45m each). Proposed times: Mon 11/16 10:00AM PT, Tue 11/17 2:00PM PT. Jenny — please confirm which slot works for Priya/Marco.
4) Security one-pager: Monica will prepare the doc for Priya describing redaction and retention policy for recordings.
5) HubSpot: Connor has updated the deal (ACME-2026-PRD1) with action items and owners.

Action owners:
- Monica: upload recording + security one-pager (owner)
- Connor: lab scripts & ephemeral demo (owner)
- Sofia: confirm office hours and send calendar invites once Acme confirms

Jenny — any additional asks before I send calendar invites? If not, I’ll schedule and attach the Drive links & lab worksheet to the invites.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com
